# Development figure trials

This directory contains source-grounded figure builders, authored redraws,
topology fixtures and review records. These are development examples, not a
stable publication certification.

Original paper PDFs, extracted paper text and screenshots remain local and are
excluded from Git. Source URLs, precise locators and expected SHA-256 hashes are
recorded in the FigureSpec evidence records and trial documentation. To rerun a
paper-grounded builder or evidence validator, obtain the cited paper version and
place it at the recorded local path (usually `paper.pdf` beside the builder).
Hash checks deliberately fail if a different source version is substituted.

The DETR trial also contains a local-only photograph excerpt with raster
detection boxes. Its PDF, PPTX, SVG and PNG exports are not redistributed here.
Its source code, FigureSpec, fixtures and review records are included. Replace
the excerpt with a licensed original photo and native detection boxes before
publishing a derivative output. Local links to excluded evidence and DETR
exports in the review documents are retained as audit locators.

Other committed figure outputs are authored redraws; the CLIP example uses a
separately documented CC0 replacement photograph. See each trial's provenance
and limitations before reuse.
